values.note: Older campground with short parking spurs (30-35 ft; the forest's status table lists 30 ft max) that the FS says will not take larger RVs; vehicles must fit on the spur, no parking off the road. Up to 8 people a site.

The parking length ranges from 30 to 35 feet.') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/conditions (North Fork Poudre: 9 sites, Max Spur 30'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS (Arapaho-Roosevelt NF, Canyon Lakes Ranger District) campground on the north side of gravel Deadman Road (CR 86) about 7 mi west of Red Feather Lakes, ~9,200 ft, in dense lodgepole pine near the North Fork of the Cache la Poudre. --Claude
summary: FS page + ARP status table: confirmed 9 sites, $19, FCFS, vault toilets, no water. Added max_rig_ft 35 (spurs 30-35 ft), season 06-12..11-08. Note rewritten (dropped field facts and the unsourced washboard/no-4WD line).
flags: Website is the ARP recreation index (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation); replace with the campground's own page https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/north-fork-poudre-campground.
Missing phone: Canyon Lakes Ranger District 970-295-6600 (ARP offices page).

Rig-length wording: the FS page says 'This is an older facility with short parking spurs that will not accommodate larger RVs' - singled out for this campground - but states the spurs as 30-35 ft (ARP status table: Max Spur 30'). A 23-ft rig fits either figure, so this is wording only; recorded 35.

Road: Deadman Road (CR 86) Lower and Upper both 'OPEN' on the ARP conditions road table (updated 10/14/2026). The Cameron Peak Fire road-closure order 02-10-05-26-01 (Apr 16 - Nov 30, 2026) lists FR 129, 177, 154.C, 152.1/152.2, 344.0, 345.B - not Deadman Road. The old note's 'washboarded, no 4WD' is not on any FS page; dropped.

Waterfront (stored not waterfront): the FS page says 'near the banks of the North Fork Cache la Poudre River'. On Esri imagery around the pin there is only Deadman Road and dense lodgepole - no river within ~300 m of the pin. Consistent with the stored call.
Pin 40.81387,-105.71 is ~70 m from the FS coordinate 40.813294,-105.710616, on the north side of the road as the FS describes. No rec.gov listing.
Status: FS banner 'Site Open'; season to Nov 8.
